extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: A dataset for semantic-controlled video generation containing over 100K curated paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions, spanning concept, style, camera, and motion categories.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was bootstrapped by curating 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet and automatically generating paired videos using image-to-video visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs, matching each image to compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw/source data consisted of 2K high-quality reference images collected from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases; these were used with visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs to generate paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Paired semantic labels were created automatically by matching curated reference images to compatible image-to-video visual-effects templates representing semantic conditions, rather than through manual human labeling.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial APIs/models including VIDU and Kling, plus community LoRAs, were used as automated tools to generate the paired semantic-controlled videos.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from the commercial models and community LoRAs used to generate it.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: VAP-Data has limited semantic conditions, is synthetic rather than real-world, and depends on generated captions/reference-target alignment; inaccurate semantic descriptions or large subject mismatch can degrade generation quality. The dataset is also derived from source templates whose weaknesses transfer to the model.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper discusses misuse risks including identity impersonation, deepfakes, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and sexualized or violent media, and frames the system as research-only with mitigations such as content filters and acceptable-use restrictions.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The collected reference images span demographic and subject categories including men, women, and children.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset/system is intended for research, education, and creative prototyping in semantic-controlled video generation, including evaluation on concept, style, motion, and camera control; it is explicitly not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk uses.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Any release will be accompanied by a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy prohibiting abusive or unlawful scenarios.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Collected 2K high-quality reference images, then created paired videos by matching each image to compatible Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs; for evaluation, evenly sampled 24 semantic conditions with 2 samples each.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos were resized to 480×720 (832) and 49 frames were sampled at 16 fps.
